title: Sentences
info: A sentence is a complete thought. It starts with a capital letter and usually ends with a full stop, question mark, or exclamation mark.
A complete sentence names someone or something and tells what they do or are.

questions.q: Which one is a complete sentence?
Which mark ends the telling sentence "I like maps"?
Which is NOT a complete sentence?
Type the end mark for the telling sentence "I can swim".
